title: Lekalo workflow-provider capabilities manifest
description: Closed contract of the issue #34 AIFHub-consumable discovery handshake emitted by `lekalo provider describe --json`: one `status: valid` receipt whose `manifest` object advertises the workflow-provider contract identity, the exact product version, the pinned upstream output contract identities, the closed operation vocabulary, and the workflow bounds. The manifest is deterministic metadata of the producing binary: no host identity, no timestamps, no paths, and no lifecycle operation (`init`, `install`, `update`, `sync`, `cleanup`, `migrate`) is ever advertised. Detection is the manifest plus the installed-tool check the consumer performs; a supported operation never implies a configured project or target. The contract version is the product version of its implementation commit per docs/versioning.md; the upstream pins keep their own independent family versions.

status.description: The single valid status of the discovery receipt. Discovery itself never fails closed on a missing project: it has none.

schemaDiscriminator.description: The exact `lekalo/<family>/v<version>` wire discriminator of one upstream contract family.

operationId.description: The closed operation vocabulary. Detection is not an operation.

effectClass.description: read-only operations never write; generated-artifacts operations write only into the governed .lekalo/** generated/lock custody and never into OpenSpec/HLV canonical paths.

recommendedContextBudgetTokens.description: The recommended `lekalo context` budget inside a workflow run; strictly below the hard bound.

maxExportBytes.description: The exact maximum canonical impact/trace export bytes.

schemaVersion.description: The exact wire discriminator of this workflow-provider contract.

identity.description: The exact contract identity of this workflow-provider contract.

productVersion.description: The exact product version of the producing binary.

discoveryCommand.description: The discovery command in presentation form.

targetProtocolIdentity.description: The exact target-protocol identity: a supported workflow operation never implies a configured target, and generation additionally requires an installed adapter program.

schemaPins.description: The pinned upstream output contract identities, sorted by schemaVersion, unique, and covering exactly the seven families referenced by operations plus the diagnostic envelope.

operations.description: The advertised operations in canonical (sorted) order, unique ids.

manifestDigest.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the manifest with this field removed. Integrity metadata, not a signature.
